thread:
vivian (People Ops): Quick kickoff: summer culture week is on and we're coordinating spot awards + micro-recognition moments at the picnic. We have 12 x $75 cards and a few surprise swag crates. Nominate folks or micro-teams by next Tue. Form: <https://forms.gle/summer-culture-noms> :sun_with_face:

joel (People Ops): Logistics: manager ok required for payouts, finance needs final roster by 07/10 for payroll. For swag, include shipping addr and size. We'll try to surface 3 micro-stories during the picnic stage slot.

samir (Eng): Can ICs nominate peers? want to make sure engineering guild can shout out maintainers who stepped up during the outage runbook rewrite.

vivian (People Ops): Yes — peers can nominate. Managers confirm before payout. Peer shoutouts encouraged.

nora (CS): Any restrictions on contractors? we have a community contractor who organized a volunteer drive. Would love to recognize them.

marta (Finance): Contractors need vendor routing or non-monetary swag only (per legal). If you nominate a contractor, mark "swag" only and loop legal. Also note: $75 cards are taxable in the US. Intl tax varies. Include legal name + country on the form.

recognition-bot: Nomination reminder set for 3 days before close. :bell:

joel (People Ops): We'll publish winners on slide deck and announce in all-hands after picnic. Managers: please add a 1-2 line anecdote in the approval column to help with storytelling.

vivian (People Ops): TL;DR: nominate by Tue, manager confirmation required, finance deadline 07/10, contractors = swag only unless routed via vendor. I'll post the sheet and an approval checklist. Thanks! :sparkles:
